tasks.title: ISTEDA Wristband Selfie
tasks.text: Upload a selfie wearing your ISTEDA wristband. Make sure the wristband is clearly visible.

tasks.title: ISTEDA Cap & Wristband
tasks.text: Take a photo of yourself wearing both the exclusive ISTEDA cap and wristband.

tasks.title: ISTEDA Team Selfie
tasks.text: Take a group selfie with at least five ISTEDA team members.

tasks.title: ISTEDA Member Selfie
tasks.text: Take a selfie with an ISTEDA member of the opposite gender.

tasks.title: ISTEDA Face Challenge
tasks.text: Get one of these expressions on camera: Vyshu crying, Maha laughing, Dona blushing, or Lino looking angry. Choose any one.

tasks.title: Meet the New Members
tasks.text: Take a selfie with three ISTEDA members who joined on or after the OKP event.

tasks.title: Q1. Dubai Run Throwback
tasks.text: Can you find someone wearing an older Dubai Run shirt and take a photo showing both editions? Can you get three different years in one shot?

tasks.title: Q2. Shoe Twin
tasks.text: Can you find a runner wearing the same shoe brand and colour as you and take a photo showing both pairs?

tasks.title: Q3. The Runner Rectangle
tasks.text: Can you find four Dubai Run participants from outside ISTEDA and form a rectangle with your arms together? Ask a friend to take the photo.

tasks.title: Q4. Match the Reference Photo
tasks.text: Can you recreate either reference photo from the same spot and angle? Choose the Al Boursa St 200 m sign or Texas Chicken.

tasks.title: Q5. Direction Challenge ↪️📸
tasks.text: Can you find a left-turn or right-turn road sign and strike a dramatic pose pointing or leaning in the same direction? Ask a friend to capture you and the sign together.

tasks.title: Q1. Reverse Bibs
tasks.text: Can you find a runner whose bib ends with your last two digits reversed? If yours ends in 27, look for 72. Take a selfie showing both bibs.

tasks.title: Q2. Sheikh Zayed Road Jump 📸
tasks.text: Can you jump from one white dash toward the next on a clear stretch of the closed Sheikh Zayed Road route? Ask a friend to photograph you with both feet off the ground.

tasks.title: Q3. Triple 7
tasks.text: Can you find a runner whose bib contains three 7s anywhere in the number? Take a selfie with them holding up seven fingers.

tasks.title: Q4. Birthday Challenge
tasks.text: Can you find a runner whose bib ends with your birth day of the month? If you were born on the 21st, look for 21. Take a selfie while they point to the matching digits.

tasks.title: Q5. Maths Match
tasks.text: Can you find a runner whose final bib digit adds to 10 with yours, like 6 and 4, 9 and 1, or 2 and 8? Take a selfie showing both bibs and the numbers on your fingers. If yours ends in 0, find runners ending in 9 and 1 and show all three bibs in one photo.

tasks.title: Best Photography Award · 4 points
tasks.text: Submit any photo related to Dubai Run. The winning photo earns 4 points.

tasks.title: Best Selfie · 4 points
tasks.text: Take a selfie with something related to Dubai Run. The winning selfie earns 4 points.

tasks.title: Most Calories Burned · 5 points
tasks.text: Upload a screenshot or other proof showing your total calories burned on Dubai Run day.
